main.description: Returns the indexed evaluation at the given AT-URI with its publisher and evaluator views. Invalid evaluator entries are omitted from the hydrated projection while the original record is preserved. Authentication is not required.

uri.description: AT-URI of the evaluation record, using a DID authority; lookup is by URI only, not a specific CID/version.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The URI is invalid or does not identify an evaluation record.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: No indexed evaluation was found at this AT-URI.

evaluatorView.description: An evaluator DID with its profile and organization when they were looked up and found. Absent keys mean not looked up or not found.

evaluationView.description: Evaluation with the original record, hydrated publisher, and evaluator projections. The record is not rewritten when evaluator data is malformed. A missing or non-array evaluator container yields an empty hydrated array; malformed entries are omitted. Missing profile or organization sidecars are omitted from evaluators; query or hydration failures fail the request. Evaluator arrays over 1000 entries still fail exact lookup and are skipped by lists.

evaluators.description: Dense projection of valid record.evaluators object entries with valid DIDs, preserving their source order and duplicates. Entries with malformed shapes or invalid DIDs are omitted without changing the original record; a missing or non-array source yields an empty array. The first 100 response entries get their profile and organization looked up; later entries carry only the did. The raw evaluator array is limited to 1000 entries; over-limit records fail exact lookup and are skipped by lists.
